name: Atomic Gadgets (infinite power)
description: Needs the moddable-engine build (level 6) and the Own Music Player mod.  Atomic versions of everyday gadgets that run forever on a radioisotope cell, like the vanilla atomic reading light: mp3 player, smartphone, laptop, e-ink tablet, handheld game system, radio, camera, smart watch, soldering iron and electric blanket.  They have no battery slot and never run flat.  They give off no radiation.  They are very rare loot, found in the places where the vanilla atomic reading light turns up.  Only the radio, the soldering iron and the electric blanket can be crafted (they can in vanilla too): Applied science 10, Fabrication 10, Electronics 6, from the normal item, betavoltaic cells, a power supply and cable.
